t: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: The Big Plot
d: Found among the wreckage of a crashed plane are parts of an atomic bomb and Peter uncovers a plot to start a Third World War.

t: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: Secret Experiment
d: After a freak accident while conducting a secret experiment with light refraction, Dr. Peter Brady is transformed into an invisible man.

t: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: Crises in the Desert
d: The British government recruits Brady to go behind lines in the Middle East and rescue one of their top secret agents who has been taken prisoner.

t: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: Behind the Mask
d: Brady helps a horribly disfigured man to become invisible but is soon caught in lies that threaten to destroy the life of a notable politician.

t: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: Shadow on the Screen
d: Peter must board a vessel to rescue a sailor who wants to defect. However, a trap has been set using radar to detect the Invisible Man on a TV screen.

t: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: The Mink Coat
d: While vacationing, Peter's sister becomes convinced that the inner-lining of an airplane passenger's fur coat is being used for smuggling purposes.

t: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: The Locked Room
d: Peter must infiltrate an embassy to rescue a Russian scientist who wants to defect and has been working to solve the problem of invisibility.

t: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: Jail Break
d: Peter vows to help an innocent men unjustly sentenced to prison for a crime he didn't commit and must find the real thief.

t: H.G. Wells' The Invisible Man: Blind Justice
d: When an airline pilot is framed for drug smuggling, a killer comes to his home to silence him... and the pilot's blind wife (Honor Blackman) is the only witness.

t: Beyond Belief: Fact or Fiction: Episode 3
d: This episode features the following cases: The Wall, The Chalkboard, The Getaway, The Prescription, Summer Camp.

t: Beyond Belief: Fact or Fiction: Episode 5
d: This episode features the following cases: The Land, Titan, The Diary, Town of Remembrance, The House on Barry Avenue.

t: Beyond Belief: Fact or Fiction: Episode 6
d: This episode features the following cases: Bright Light, Magic Mightyman, The Student, Scribbles, Count Mystery.
